summary.intent: Determine whether the failed CI run on trail 180 and the cancelled CI run on trail 198 (PR #442) were caused by timeouts, and find the root cause.
summary.outcome: Both PR #442 runs were cancelled with no failed step in the macOS preflight jobs. The assistant concluded macos-14 runners are no longer scheduled, and moved the macOS runner from macos-14 to macos-15 in callisto-ci.yml and callisto-release.yml. The change is committed and pushed on branch ci/macos-15-runners, cut from origin/main, and the two release-workflow verify scripts were run. The transcript does not show their output, and it does not show a PR being opened.

repo: CI workflow is .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml and release workflow is .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml; the 'Release Artifact Preflight' jobs run on macOS runners.
The release workflow's build-artifact job also used macos-14, so the next release would have hit the same failure as CI.
Release workflow checks live in .github/tests: verify-release-workflow-policy.sh and verify-release-workflow-contract.sh.
Runner labels are set via 'runner: macos-14' keys in the workflow matrices, so a single sed replaces them.

code.finding: Contains the macOS runner matrix entry (runner: macos-14) that was changed to macos-15.
The build-artifact job uses runner: macos-14, changed to macos-15.

workflow: For cancelled GitHub Actions runs, check the cancelled jobs' steps, runner_name and annotations via gh api to tell timeouts and concurrency cancellation apart from runner unavailability.
Fix unrelated infra problems on a separate branch cut from origin/main instead of the feature branch (here fix/tag-push-explicit-refspec).

friction: gh run view output for cancelled jobs showed no failed step, so the root cause had to be inferred from runner and annotation data over several commands.
The same gh run view query was run twice, and several greps were needed to locate the workflow files and runner labels.
open_items: Confirm the runner diagnosis: the transcript never shows direct evidence that macos-14 is unavailable beyond the cancelled jobs.
Open a PR for ci/macos-15-runners and rerun CI on #442 once it merges.
Docs or specs that mention the macOS runner version were grepped but the results are not shown; check whether any need updating.
